# gitea_secret_backend (Resource)

Mounts the Gitea secrets engine and writes its connection config and seeded admin credentials. `admin_password` and `ca_cert` are write-only and kept from state; after an out-of-band `config/rotate-root`, update `admin_password` before re-applying or Terraform will set the old password back.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gitea_secret_backend" "gitea" {
  path      = "gitea"
  gitea_url = "https://gitea.example.com"
  ca_cert   = file("${path.module}/gitea-ca.pem")

  admin_username = "vault-admin"
  admin_password = var.gitea_admin_password

  request_timeout_seconds = 30
}

variable "gitea_admin_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `admin_password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the Gitea site admin (Basic Auth). Write-only; never read back. Rotate it out of band with `vault write -f <path>/config/rotate-root`.
- `admin_username` (String) Username of the Gitea site admin whose Basic-Auth credentials the engine uses.
- `gitea_url` (String) Base URL of the Gitea server (e.g. https://gitea.example.com).
- `path` (String) Mount path for the Gitea secrets engine (e.g. "gitea").

### Optional

- `admin_login_name` (String) login_name sent to Gitea's admin edit API during rotate-root (defaults to admin_username server-side).
- `admin_source_id` (Number) Authentication source ID of the admin user for rotate-root. Defaults to `0` (local users).
- `ca_cert` (String) PEM CA certificate that signed the Gitea server's TLS certificate.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the mount.
- `plugin` (String) Registered plugin name/type to mount. Defaults to `vault-plugin-secrets-gitea`.
- `request_timeout_seconds` (Number) HTTP timeout in seconds for calls from the plugin to Gitea. Defaults to `30`.
- `tls_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS verification of the Gitea server (not recommended). Defaults to `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by mount path. Import only sets `path`; `admin_password` and `ca_cert`
# are never read back, so they must be set in configuration and are written to
# the backend again on the next apply.
terraform import gitea_secret_backend.gitea gitea
```
